title: PM launches country’s first hydrogen train, takes jibe at Congress and AAP
description: Mr. Modi says had “Hormuz” situation occurred before 2014, the Indian Railways would have come to a standstill as trains in most of the country ran solely on diesel; he points out that nearly 99% of India’s railway network has been electrified in the last 12 years; PM lashes out at AAP leaders for indulging in ‘extortion, illegal collection, and unauthorised possessions’ as part of their political culture
